final: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(ab.abhvreg) as cnt, COUNT(ab.abhvreg) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(ab.abhvreg)) OVER () as share_pct FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt FROM type_counts) SELECT SUM(tc.cnt) as combined_count, AVG(tc.share_pct) as avg_share, AVG(tc.cnt - s.avg_cnt) as avg_distance_above_average FROM type_counts tc, stats s WHERE tc.cnt > s.avg_cnt
